deep_analysis:
Portfolio: 2 open (1 long ETH, 1 short SOL), net ~flat. 24h closed cohort 30T 43.3% WR net -$0.17. Chop-bleed 7d dollar share 94.4% (79/88 never-armed losers, 0 NULL mfe_pct, same-day arm rate 37.5% n=8) — above the 92% entry-quality tripwire; 14d 90.4% / 30d 86.0%. Nearly every dollar of recent loss comes from entries that never reached +0.40% MFE for trail to arm. That is an entry-quality problem, not an exit problem — do not spend cycles on trail/stop tweaks.

ETH LONG #16644 (jup_yolo_mirrored, 4.3h, +0.23%, entry meta_rsi 42.6): thesis intact. Aligned with continuum LEAN_BULL (BTC above EMA300 495 min, zscore STRONG_POS, wyckoff MARKUP). Would open fresh today. Hold; no stop action until +0.2% more MFE for BE.

SOL SHORT #16641 (jup_yolo_mirrored, 7.1h, -0.42%, entry meta_rsi 80.49 overbought-fade): this is the wrong side of a BTC markup tape. Continuum 1m LEAN_BULL / ABOVE EMA300; SOL grinding up in the top of its 1h range (live 1m RSI ~70). SL 96.036 is only ~0.06% above live price 95.98 — market will resolve it within a candle or two. Would NOT open fresh: shorting into an 8h+ BTC-above-EMA300 markup is fade-the-pump against trend, not with it. No manual action required beyond accepting the SL as thesis invalidation; if price somehow reverses before SL, do not re-add.

Regime sources disagree and must be stated with source: 15m aggregate LONG_BIAS (26 long / 10 short / 89 neutral), 15m BTC scanner NEUTRAL (0 flips/24h — unusually stable), continuum LEAN_BULL/ABOVE, 4h scanner SHORT_BIAS, aggregate flip rate 25/24h (normal high-churn standing state, p95=26). Long-biased entries are the continuum-aligned side; 4h SHORT_BIAS is the only bearish voice.

24h failure pattern: pump-chain- LONG atr_sl_hit cluster (FIL rsi 38, DOT 37.5, ICP 25, HYPER 50) — all MFE <0.07%, never armed. HYPE jup_yolo long hard_max_loss pair (-4.0% / -5.4%) alongside many small trailed HYPE winners — HYPE is the highest-frequency coin in the book. volume-buildup- shorts (KAS rsi 35.6, SAND 41.1) entered below the general short floor band and both lost; n=2, watch only.

Winning side in the same 24h: trailed longs on HYPE/ETC/JUP/SOL-short that armed (+0.5 to +0.67% MFE), plus GMX pump-chain- long at extreme oversold meta_rsi 25 that ran +5.6% MFE. Winners entered with either trailable momentum or deep-oversold continuation — not mid-band knife catches.
regime_context: Mixed tape, source-labeled. Continuum (1m BTC): ABOVE EMA300 for 495 min, LEAN_BULL, zscore STRONG_POS, wyckoff MARKUP, trend_quality STRONG_UP, linreg_alignment 0.75 — bullish structure. 15m regime scanner: aggregate LONG_BIAS (26/10/89), BTC per-regime NEUTRAL with 0 flips/24h (stable). 4h scanner: SHORT_BIAS. Aggregate flip rate 25/24h = normal churn (p95=26), not an anomaly. Implication: LONG entries are continuum-aligned; SHORT entries fight the 1m/15m tape and only have 4h cover. SOL open short is in that fighting bucket. Volatility NORMAL; no regime kill warranted.
